prompt: Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Roboto; condensed heading with regular interface text. Use Spectrum 2-3: page #FBF9FA, text #2D211F, accent #86851D, secondary surface #E7EFE8, text on accent #111111. Use body 16px, heading 28px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
